_info: Events on the act map. options[].effects: glory (+/- glory; negative = cost, the option is unavailable without enough glory), heal / wound {who: all|random|wounded, frac}, gift {kind: passive|oath} (a random passive/oath for a random hero it fits), fled {key: count} (enemies who return at the boss). text = what is written to the chronicle.

poutnik.name: The Pilgrim by the Road
poutnik.text: An old pilgrim in a ragged cloak sits at the crossroads. He claims he once served the Count, and offers to hear the oath of anyone who dares.

options.label: Swear an oath before the pilgrim
options.hint: A hero without an oath swears a random oath.
options.text: An oath was sworn before the pilgrim at the crossroads.

options.label: Give him alms (15 glory)
options.hint: The pilgrim blesses the house: everyone heals 25 %.
options.text: The house gave the pilgrim alms and he blessed it.

vypalena_ves.name: The Burned Village
vypalena_ves.text: Only smouldering beams are left of the village. The brigands who set it alight are running for the forest with their loot.

options.label: Pursue the arsonists
options.hint: +30 glory, one hero is wounded (40 % health).
options.text: The house caught the arsonists of the burned village.

options.label: Help the survivors
options.hint: You gain nothing, but 3 brigands escape and return in the fight with the Captain.
options.text: The house helped the survivors of the burned village; the arsonists vanished into the forest.

zajatec.name: The Captured Brigand
zajatec.text: The watch has caught a young brigand. He begs for his life and offers to reveal where his fellows hid healing herbs.

options.label: Release him for the herbs
options.hint: Everyone heals 20 %, but the brigand returns in the fight with the Captain.
options.text: The captured brigand revealed the herb cache and was released.

kaple.name: The Forest Chapel
kaple.text: Deep in the forest stands an abandoned chapel. A silver reliquary lies on the altar, a strange silence around it.

options.label: Pray
options.text: The house prayed in the forest chapel.

options.label: Take the reliquary
options.hint: One hero gains a random passive, everyone loses 15 % health.
options.text: The house carried off the reliquary from the forest chapel.
